question: In a certain code language, ZIGSAW is written as BOHTEX and BLUFF is written as CMAGG. How will MOVEMENT be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 **The vowels are coded as next vowel in the order A,E,I,O,U.

 The consonants are increased to 1 positional value.

 The consonants when increased if land on a vowel then it is increased by 1 again i.e. +2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37b071655c1f610a0f976937476bcab122bf97e5067e0785fb4a85ced1763310.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cea8d5e641b4132e147bbf6f451017c1a1d6893f5493cb40560942e1eb1b2566.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fca037ebb71f2743dd8fd79908de18fb9b59f9a3b5b2b556d59ef32ff772acfe.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
